summary: Filing is a routine Form 6-K by NuCana plc reporting Q1 2026 financial results via unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements, management discussion and analysis, and a press release. The exhibits cover standard quarterly financial data, including R&D expenses, operating loss, and cash position. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a periodic earnings report with no transactional or extraordinary corporate action.
